claims.claim_text: Heath's agency manages 523,782 negative keywords across all client accounts to maximize ROAS.
The agent processes search terms in batches of roughly 120 terms; one batch on Gemini 3 Pro takes about 60–78 seconds, so ~1,000 terms takes roughly 10+ minutes.
claims.source_quote: it's going to analyze 120 search terms for each batch. This one took 78 seconds. So, times by 10, what's that? 780 seconds roughly for a,000 keywords.
